verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only lists a 'Web Scraping & Search' feature heading. It does not document an agent that drives a real browser to navigate, log in, click, or extract from live authenticated pages. Scraping is an adjacent capability, and MCP compatibility or custom skills are developer building blocks, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a power user, the assistant can drive a real browser — navigate, log in, click, and extract from live pages on my behalf
